summary: Users import any Cetus LP position (any pool/pair). Block10 rebalances; 2% of per-asset realized profit above import basis goes to ops wallets.

fee.definition: Profit = USD value withdrawn or compounded above the user's imported cost basis for that position. No fee on principal. Fee is taken in the profit asset(s) at harvest/rebalance settle.
fee.recipientNote: 2% of realized rebalance profits is paid to ops wallets only. It does not go to BTEN LP vaults or emission buckets.

userFlow.import: User connects wallet, picks any Cetus Position NFT, sets cost basis + rebalance params, signs enroll_cetus_position.
userFlow.updateParams: User can call update_enrollment_params anytime (max deviation, slippage, recenter, allow OOR close).
userFlow.remove: User can withdraw_enrolled_position anytime while not mid-operator-take; or settle_exit_with_coins after a closed exit (2% fee on realized profit above basis).
userFlow.rebalance: BTEN operator takes position, rebalances per user params, returns position NFT to enrollment.
userFlow.fee: 2% of per-asset realized profit above import basis to ops on settle/exit only — never on principal.

eligibility.note: Any Cetus position NFT can be enrolled. Swaps during rebalance still prefer BTEN-gated routes when a BTEN hop is available.

operator.rebalancer: laptop/bten_lp_rebalance_daemon.mjs pattern extended to enrolled user positions
operator.gas: SUI gas only from operator budget; never spend user SUI principal for inventory

mustShow: gate status (live tape treats shown trades as gated)

gatePolicy.rule: Managed-vault value-moving flows prefer protected BTEN-gated adapters with min-out and one receipt per finished route. Live-tape classification treats every shown trade as gated and never labels a row ungated for missing RouteRecorded; external Cetus BTEN legs are included via attestation rather than blocked.
allowedPaths: turbos adapters with the same seal rule
external Cetus BTEN pool volume attested via ExternalCetusRouteAttested
gatePolicy.notABanList: This policy does not forbid aggregator or direct Cetus volume from appearing on the live tape; those rows stay labeled gated (pending or completed external attestation).

liveTapeClassification.note: Every row on the block10.grok.me live tape is classified as gated. Presence or absence of RouteRecorded must never flip the tape label to ungated. Routes that touch registered BTEN Cetus pools without RouteRecorded remain gated (pending or completed external attestation).

lpRewards.source: BTEN LP allocation from settled blocks (EmissionState bten_lp / LpProgramState)
lpRewards.rule: Users who enroll/import eligible BTEN-pair positions receive a proportional share of BTEN LP rewards while enrolled, weighted by eligible programme liquidity.
lpRewards.note: 2% realized-profit fee goes to ops wallets only. It is separate from LP reward share. Importers keep BTEN LP reward eligibility.
